en:
Battery

Introduction

The battery class is derived from the brain base class and provides access to the V5 Brain’s battery, allowing your robot to monitor capacity, voltage, current draw, power usage, temperature, and efficiency.

Access

Brain.Battery

Member Functions

The battery class includes the following member functions:

  • voltage — Returns the battery voltage.
  • current — Returns the battery current draw.
  • capacity — Returns the brain's remaining battery capacity.
  • temperature — Returns the battery temperature.

Before calling any battery member functions, a brain instance must be created, as shown below:

// Create the V5 Brain
brain Brain = brain();

voltage

Returns the voltage of the V5 Brain battery. Voltage is the electrical pressure supplied to the battery, which can help you check whether the battery is charged enough for the robot to run reliably.

Available Functions

double voltage( voltageUnits units = voltageUnits::volt );

Parameters

Parameter Type Description
units voltageUnits Optional. The unit used to represent voltage: volt (default) — volts, or mV — millivolts

Return Values

Returns a double representing the battery voltage in the specified units.

current

Returns the electrical current drawn from the V5 Brain battery. Current is how much electrical flow the robot is using from the battery, which can help you see how hard the robot is working or whether motors may be under extra load, ranging from 0.0 to 20.0 Amps.

Available Functions

double current( currentUnits units = currentUnits::amp );

Parameters

Parameter Type Description
units currentUnits Optional. The unit used to represent current: amp (default) — amperes

Return Values

Returns a double representing the electrical current drawn from the V5 Brain battery in amperes.

capacity

Returns the remaining battery level of the V5 Brain battery.

Available Functions

uint32_t capacity( percentUnits units = percentUnits::pct );

Parameters

Parameter Type Description
units percentUnits Optional. The unit used to represent battery capacity: pct / percent — percent

Return Values

Returns a uint32_t representing the remaining battery capacity as a percentage from 0% to 100%.

temperature

Returns the temperature of the V5 Brain battery.

Available Functions

1 — Returns the battery temperature as a percentage.

double temperature(
    percentUnits units = percentUnits::pct );

2 — Returns the battery temperature in the specified temperature units.

double temperature(
    temperatureUnits units );

Parameters

Parameter Type Description
units percentUnits Optional. The unit used to represent battery temperature: pct / percent (default) — percent
units temperatureUnits Returns the battery temperature in specific units: celsius — degrees Celsius, or fahrenheit — degrees Fahrenheit

Return Values

Returns a double representing the remaining battery temperature in the specified units.

Notes

  • The operating temperature range for the battery is approximately 20°C (68°F) to 70°C (158°F).
zh:
电池

概述

battery类派生自brain基类，并提供对 V5 主控器电池的访问，使您的机器人能够监控容量、电压、电流消耗、电量使用情况、温度和效率。

访问

Brain.Battery

成员函数

battery类包含以下成员函数：

  • voltage— 返回电池电压。
  • current— 返回电池电流消耗。
  • capacity— 返回主控制器的剩余电池电量。
  • temperature— 返回电池温度。

在调用任何battery成员函数之前，必须创建一个brain实例，如下所示：

// Create the V5 Brain
brain Brain = brain();

voltage

返回V5主控器电池电压。电压是提供给电池的电压，可以帮助您检查电池电量是否足够机器人可靠运行。

函数重载

double voltage( voltageUnits units = voltageUnits::volt );

参数

参数 类型 说明
units voltageUnits 选修的。用于表示电压的单位：volt（默认）— 伏特，或mV— 毫伏

返回值

返回double，以指定单位表示电池电压。

current

返回从 V5 主控制器电池汲取的电流。电流是机器人使用电池的电流量，它可以帮助您了解机器人的工作强度或电机是否可能承受额外负载，范围从 0.0 到 20.0 安培。

函数重载

double current( currentUnits units = currentUnits::amp );

参数

参数 类型 说明
units currentUnits 可选。用于表示电流的单位：amp（默认）—安培

返回值

返回double，表示从 V5 主控器电池汲取的电流（以安培为单位）。

capacity

返回V5主控器电池的剩余电量。

函数重载

uint32_t capacity( percentUnits units = percentUnits::pct );

参数

参数 类型 说明
units percentUnits 可选。用于表示电池容量的单位：pct/percent— 百分比

返回值

返回uint32_t，以 0% 到 100% 的百分比表示剩余电池容量。

temperature

返回V5主控器电池的温度。

函数重载

1—以百分比形式返回电池温度。

double temperature(
    percentUnits units = percentUnits::pct );

2—以指定温度单位返回电池温度。

double temperature(
    temperatureUnits units );

参数

参数 类型 说明
units percentUnits 可选。用于表示电池温度的单位：pct/percent（默认）—百分比
units temperatureUnits 返回特定单位的电池温度：celsius— 摄氏度，或fahrenheit— 华氏度

返回值

返回double，以指定单位表示剩余电池温度。

说明与注意事项

  • 电池的工作温度范围约为20°C(68°F) 至70°C(158°F)。
